clips.title: The story
paras: Lieutenant Nevell is an officer of the Argent Dawn stationed outside the gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. Serving as a bulwark against the spreading darkness of the Scourge, he coordinates local defenders and alerts arriving adventurers to undead threats probing the dwarf kingdom's borders.

While the Argent Dawn is most renowned for holding the line in the shattered Plaguelands of Lordaeron, its vigilance reaches far into the south. Stationed in the freezing winds outside Ironforge, Lieutenant Nevell represents the order's proactive defense against necromantic incursions. When Scourge activity stirs in the mountain passes of Dun Morogh, Nevell directs recruits and capable adventurers toward the front lines to ensure Ironforge's snowy doorstep remains secure.
